method_specification.motivation_grounded.reason: The motivation specifically contrasts hierarchy-derived diagnostics with ensembles, Bayesian/dropout uncertainty, learned uncertainty estimators, distance-based diagnostics, and conformal calibration. two_baseline_reporting.paper_as_reported.reason: The reported source-paper numerical benchmarks have specific table/row or section/figure references in the manuscript and accompanying audit, including accuracy, outlier rates, parameter counts, training settings, and timing.

baseline_verification.reimpl_run_on_le8_.reason: The primary runs document a 21,799-molecule ≤8-heavy-atom pool partitioned into 18,799 training, 1,000 validation, and 2,000 in-distribution test molecules. experimental_completeness.seed_count.reason: Five independent primary seeds completed at the required network architecture. Five additional initialization-control seeds also completed, exceeding the task's three-seed minimum.

experimental_completeness.full_test_set_.reason: The saved evaluation indices for every primary seed match the complete retained inventory of 109,024 nine-heavy-atom QM9 molecules. experimental_completeness.motif_assignme.reason: The assignment archive contains a 14×109,024 motif-membership matrix with molecule identifiers. Discovery and evaluation masks partition that full inventory, and cumulative attribution uses unions so overlapping matches are not counted repeatedly.

conformational_transfer.test_executed_qu.reason: Five models were evaluated on 2,041,945 ANI-1x conformations from 14,835 molecular connectivity classes. The analysis applies the entire motif library, reports per-motif relative-energy errors and tests, distinguishes absent or undersampled motifs, and discusses transfer and downstream limitations. Three represented motifs transfer over the full energy range; eight of ten testable motifs transfer in the near-minimum window.

failure_motif_identification.motif_count.reason: Fourteen statistically characterized motifs span ring topology and strain, heteroatom composition, unsaturation, aromatic nitrogen environments, and charge-separated N–O chemistry. failure_motif_identification.statistical.reason: Every library entry has coverage, conditional mean and percentile errors, matching-versus-nonmatching comparisons, and one-sided Mann–Whitney p-values with reported adjusted values and effect sizes. failure_motif_identification.motif_defin.reason: All selected motifs have deterministic assignment rules: explicit descriptor thresholds, the SMARTS predicate [!#6;r4], or exact Morgan environment identifiers with specified radii and extraction code. uncertainty_calibration.ece_reported.reason: The reported held-out normalized ECE is 0.02807±0.00498 across five seeds, below 0.05. Its definition and seed-resolved values are provided.

uncertainty_calibration.precision_recall.reason: The submission reports a 60-threshold quantile sweep and chooses the operating point by discovery-set F1. Held-out precision is approximately 0.371±0.010 and recall 0.613±0.013 for errors above 1 kcal/mol; false-positive and false-negative rates are also reported.

motif_compactness.pareto_analysis_qualit.reason: The first four motifs jointly cover 83.88% of held-out failures, with K80=4 in every primary seed. The first three cover 77.61%, confirming that four is the smallest qualifying rank in the reported ordering.

mechanism_analysis.subsection_present.reason: An explicit Results subsection, Why these motifs break the hierarchy, contains atom- and order-resolved analyses, mechanism tables, and discussion.

mechanism_analysis.depth.reason: The analysis quantitatively connects several motif families to first- versus second-order corrections, ring geometry, frozen dressed-atom energies, and the absence of explicit charge channels. It does not supply a corresponding explanation for every motif: notably, the largest-ring-size ≥6 entry has a negative second-order excess without an explanation of its hierarchy-failure mechanism.

failure_analysis.subsection_present.reason: The dedicated section Where the analysis fails addresses both failures outside the motif library and errors made by the uncertainty estimator.

failure_analysis.uncovered_molecules_add.reason: Uncovered failures are quantified at about 1,315 per seed, or 9.9% of failures, and compared with covered failures by error magnitude and structural descriptors. The discussion connects the residual population to geometric effects unavailable to graph-only predicates; saved descriptors characterize differences in ring counts and rotatable bonds.

failure_analysis.uncertainty_failures_ad.reason: Both failure types are characterized with concrete threshold-defined examples and a realized-versus-predicted scatter plot. The report identifies 4.7% low-error false alarms among the highest-uncertainty percentile and 12.1% low-uncertainty misses among errors above 2 kcal/mol, explaining conditional-mean scatter and convergence of the hierarchy to an incorrect energy.

compute_cost_analysis.subsection_present.reason: A dedicated Computational cost section discusses training duration, epoch budgets, inference, ensemble overhead, and motif matching.
